docs.title: AI-Powered Chatbot for Organic Farming Guidance in Pakistan
Description
docs.text:
This project presents an AI-powered chatbot built using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to assist Pakistani farmers in transitioning to organic farming.

The system integrates OpenAI GPT-4, LangChain, FAISS, and GeoPandas to deliver region-specific and real-time guidance based on local soil, crop, and climate data. By combining geospatial intelligence with generative AI, the chatbot provides accurate, contextual, and actionable advice for land preparation and organic certification.

Deployed via Streamlit Cloud, it features an interactive interface that detects a farmer’s agro-ecological zone using GPS and generates customized responses to support sustainable agriculture. The system was evaluated by the Pakistan Organic Association, achieving an average expert rating of 4.6/5 for accuracy, relevance, and usability.

docs.title: EDA Case Study: Tips Dataset (Seaborn)
docs.text:
This exploratory data analysis examines tipping behavior using the Seaborn Tips dataset. The analysis focuses on relationships between total bill, tip amount, customer demographics, and dining time to uncover patterns and behavioral insights using visual and statistical methods.
